park_number.description: Official POTA park reference number (e.g. US-4157).

county.description: County where the park is located.

address.description: Street or area address for the park.

supporting_info.description: Additional supporting information supplied with a community submission.

photo_urls.description: Optional photos attached to the park (community submissions or admin uploads).

search_keywords.description: Concatenated searchable text (name, reference, location, keywords) used for park search.

source.description: official = synced from the official POTA database. community = submitted by a Repeater Nation user and awaiting or approved by moderation.

verification_status.description: Moderation status. Only approved parks are visible publicly. Community submissions start as pending.

pota_status.description: Whether the park is still active in the official POTA program. Parks no longer present in a sync are flagged inactive but retained to preserve activation history.

review_notes.description: Admin notes recorded during review of a community submission.

submitted_by_name.description: Display name of the user who submitted this community park.

submitted_at.description: When the community submission was created.

last_synced_date.description: When this park was last touched by a database synchronization run.

activation_count.description: Cached count of POTA activations recorded at this park.

last_activation_date.description: Date of the most recent activation at this park.

favorites_count.description: Number of users who favorited this park.

discord_notified_at.description: Timestamp when the community submission notification was posted to Discord.
